backlog.title: Bugfix changeset 001 — restore WRITEIN-002 re-bind, activate ctrl+g in note duty, purge stale caps claims
backlog.description: Three verified bugs from the adversarial post-P1 probe pass (PRD h2.0, baseline green at HEAD 16d9f65: 47 test files / 1321 tests, tsc clean). BUG-001 (Major): the WRITEIN-002 supersede re-bind contract (spec/ui-spec.md:37, product-requirements.md:84 AC-2b, README:225-228+:279) is structurally unreachable because consumeCommittedBuffer (panel.ts:982-991, the VAL-002 fix) deletes the write-in's carrier text at commit and acceptOptionIndex (actions.ts:268-321) re-stages nothing — adjudicated RESTORE (see architecture/overview-and-adjudication.md). BUG-002 (Minor): ctrl+g dead in note duty — keys.ts:566 gates the externalEditor intercept to focus==="text" only, and openExternalEditor (panel.ts:1306-1348) would misroute note text if the gate alone were widened; atomic fork-first fix. BUG-003 (Minor): two live stale 400-char-goal-cap references (README.md:113-116, src/state.ts:324-328) contradicting CAPS-OUT-001. Fixes land with tests (TDD implied per subtask), per-file docs ride with the work (Mode A), and a final Mode-B task sweeps changeset-level docs.
